title: Junior Strategy Manager (m/f/x)
full_description:
About Us
We are seeking a dynamic Junior Strategy Manager with a strong focus on the development and operationalization of our strategic agenda, aligning with both long-term ambitions and short to mid-term priorities. In this role, you will drive and coordinate internal strategic initiatives alongside our senior leadership team, with a particular emphasis on market and competitive analysis, internal performance analysis, and high-level financial modeling and business case development levering AI tools for an efficient and comprehensive outcome.
You derive strategic options and synthesize potential solutions in a compelling narrative to be presented directly to C-level and Board-level stakeholders. You will also support the first steps of execution of agreed strategic initiatives by translating the strategy into roadmaps, define KPIs, and support as PMO. You will be responsible for managing relationships and interfaces within the organization and externally on behalf of our Chief Transformation Officer (CTO), ensuring seamless communication and collaboration across all levels.
You will play a key role in ensuring the successful execution of our strategies. As a trusted sparring partner to the CTO and senior leadership team, you will contribute to shaping the future direction of Allianz Direct.
Key Responsibilities
Support the operationalization of Allianz Direct’s strategic agenda, both in terms of long-term ambitions and short to mid-term priorities
Drive and/or coordinate strategic initiatives jointly with the senior leadership team, with a focus on performance analysis (external, internal), scenario modelling, and synthesizing results on top management level to support their decision making
Support first steps of execution of strategic initiatives, e.g. by translating the strategy into roadmaps, define KPIs, and kick-start the implementation as PMO
Manage intra-Group and external relationships and interfaces on behalf of the CTO, ensuring effective communication and collaboration during strategic projects
Act as a sparring partner to the CTO and senior leadership team, providing insights and recommendations based on thorough project analysis and management
Qualifications / Key Skills
High analytical and conceptual aptitude combined with strong project management skills
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with a proactive and independent working style
Ability to analyze complex information and data, translating insights into actionable recommendations
Expertise in challenging stakeholder management, particularly with top management, ensuring alignment and effective communication during strategic initiatives
Education & Experience
Degree in business administration, economics, natural sciences, or a related field
2+ years of experience in (top) management consulting or strategy office, with a focus performance analysis, and creation of top management presentations
Confidence in daily interaction with senior management, demonstrating expertise in managing strategic projects and initiatives
Strong proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel
Experience in using AI tools across the entire spectrum of tasks, i.e. from research activities to final delivery creation
95012 | Strategy | Professional | | Allianz Direct | Full-Time |
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
We at Allianz believe in an inclusive workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, no matter where you are from, what you look like, who you love or what you believe in. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, disability or sexual orientation.
Great to have you on board. Let's care for tomorrow.
Note: Having different strengths, experiences, perspectives and approaches is an integral part of Allianz‘ company culture. One means to achieve diverse teams is a regular rotation of Allianz Executive employees across functions, Allianz entities and geographies. Therefore, the company expects from its employees a general openness and a high motivation to regularly change positions and collect experiences across Allianz Group
.

title: Product Enablement Manager
full_description:
This role sits within Product Delivery & Enablement of our Sales Solution Division and reports into the Head of Product Enablement & Delivery.
Support and enhance product management capabilities across TUI's Digital Solutions organization by developing enablement resources, training, and best practices.
About The Job
Creating and maintaining high-quality enablement resources will be a key focus, including developing playbooks, templates, and guides that support product management activities across the organization.
You'll design and deliver engaging training sessions and workshops that enhance product management capabilities and knowledge throughout our teams.
Providing coaching and guidance to product managers will be part of your daily work, supporting them in applying best practices, methodologies, and tools to improve their effectiveness.
Supporting our product management community of practice involves organizing events, facilitating knowledge sharing, and fostering collaboration across teams.
The role includes researching and staying current with industry best practices and trends in product management, adapting and introducing relevant practices to enhance TUI's product management capabilities.
About You
You have experience in product management or related roles, with knowledge of product enablement, training, or coaching being particularly valuable.
Your strong understanding of product management methodologies and best practices will help our teams deliver exceptional digital products.
Experience creating documentation, guides, or training materials demonstrates your ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.
You possess strong facilitation and presentation skills, with excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
A passion for product management excellence and continuous improvement drives your approach to supporting and developing others.
About Our Offer
Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams
Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.
From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.
We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

title: Package Consultant - SAP HANA Sales (m/w/d)
full_description:
Introduction
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
Your Role And Responsibilities
As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA Sales, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring SAP HANA Sales solutions for clients. Your expertise will help clients optimize their sales processes, improve customer relationships, and increase revenue. Your primary responsibilities will include:
Implement SAP HANA Sales Solutions: Design and implement SAP HANA Sales solutions that meet clients' business requirements, working closely with them to ensure a smooth transition.
Provide Training and Support: Deliver training and support to clients to ensure they can effectively utilize the implemented SAP HANA Sales solutions.
Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their business requirements and design solutions that meet their needs.
Optimize Sales Processes: Help clients optimize their sales processes, improving customer relationships and increasing revenue through effective SAP HANA Sales solution implementation.
Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Exposure to SAP HANA Sales: Familiarity with implementing and configuring SAP HANA Sales solutions, including designing and delivering solutions that meet clients' business requirements.
Experience working with Client Requirements: Understanding of how to work closely with clients to gather business requirements and design solutions that meet their needs.
Implementation of Sales Solutions: Knowledge of how to implement SAP HANA Sales solutions that optimize sales processes, improve customer relationships, and increase revenue.
Solution Training and Support: Exposure to providing training and support to clients to ensure they can effectively utilize implemented SAP HANA Sales solutions.
Sales Process Optimization: Familiarity with optimizing sales processes through effective SAP HANA Sales solution implementation.
Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
SAP HANA Sales Configuration: Exposure to advanced configuration options for SAP HANA Sales solutions, including data modeling and reporting capabilities.
Sales Process Improvement: Familiarity with analyzing sales processes and identifying areas for improvement through SAP HANA Sales solution implementation.
Client Relationship Management: Experience working with clients to understand their business requirements and design solutions that meet their needs, leading to improved customer relationships.

title: Clinical Systems Analyst
full_description:
About The Job
At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.
We are seeking Clinical Systems Analysts to support, optimize, and maintain critical healthcare IT systems that power clinical operations. In this role, you will work at the intersection of clinical workflows and technical systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and usability across hospital environments.
Organization
: Alignerr
Position
: Clinical Systems Analyst
Type
: Hourly Contract
Compensation
: $30–$70 /hour
Location
: Remote
Commitment
: 10–40 hours/week
What You’ll Do
Troubleshoot, test, and optimize clinical systems by diagnosing issues, performing upgrades, and maintaining system stability.
Gather and translate clinical and operational requirements into technical solutions in collaboration with clinicians, IT, and other stakeholders.
Provide system support, training, and documentation to ensure healthcare teams can use technology effectively and reliably.
What We’re Looking For
Experience supporting or administering healthcare IT systems such as EHRs, clinical applications, or hospital infrastructure.
Strong technical troubleshooting, testing, and system optimization skills.
Ability to work with clinicians and technical teams to translate workflow needs into system configurations.
Preferred
Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
Why Join Us
Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
Potential for contract extension.
Application Process (Takes 15–20 min)
Submit your resume
Complete a short screening
Project matching and onboarding
PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your AI interview and application steps to be considered for this opportunity.

title: Sales Operations Analyst - Planning & Performance Team (m/w/d)
full_description:
AUTO1 Group is Europe’s leading digital automotive platform. We revolutionize the used car market with our well-known brands Autohero, wirkaufendeinauto.de and AUTO1.com.
Our objectives are efficiency, excellence, and continuous sales process optimization. The SP&P team focuses on making Auto1's sales approach strategic, data-driven, and deliberate. Our ultimate goal is to contribute to creating the best value proposition for our dealers by implementing standardized processes and sharing best practices across our sales organization.
Our offer
Flexible working from home:
You have the option to work from home up to 4 days a week.
You are entitled to
28 vacation days
to relax and recharge. After another year, your entitlement increases to 30 vacation days.
Attractive discount on the purchase of a new car at Autohero
– an exclusive offer just for you!
An
above-statutory contribution to the company pension scheme
. We look after you, even beyond your working hours!
Our employee platform offers numerous discounts for your purchases – benefit from exclusive perks.
Job Description
Drive sales initiatives tightly aligned to market realities and group targets
Identify, quantify, and act on sales trends and performance gaps using rigorous market and data analysis
Own sales forecasting and reporting end-to-end: Targets, dealers, tools and clear accountability for results
Deliver concise, decision-ready insights to stakeholders. Escalate blockers and push corrective actions fast
Work cross-functionally (Sales, Finance, BI, Marketing)
Qualifications
Working experience in Management Consulting, Sales Strategy & Operations or in a dynamic, fast-paced international scale-up environment
SQL knowledge, experience using GSheets and other tools to manipulate and analyze large, complex data sets, CRM experience is a plus
Excellent organization skills as well as written and verbal communication skills
Fluent in English, other EU languages are a plus
Additional Information
You do not meet 100% of the requirements? Take your shot and apply anyway! We offer room for growth and challenges to learn from.
Contact
Julia Krause

title: Field Marketing Associate Manager
full_description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
As Field Marketing Associate Manager at Veeva, you have the opportunity to learn from a high-caliber team at a high-growth company. You can make a real impact across many areas including communications, demand generation, events, and digital marketing. If you are results-driven, resourceful, strive for excellence, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect role for you.
What You'll Do
Support with the development and execution of field marketing plans; including event and webinar logistics execution, customer conference support, customer communications
Help organize and coordinate Veeva and industry events, including logistics, internal and external communications, event app management, and reporting
Assist with weekly and monthly marketing program reporting and metrics (Marketo, Lynx, Matomo, Sigma, etc.)
Coordinate with internal teams such as product marketing, creative services, content, product, communications, and digital teams to manage field marketing program components
Assist in the development and editing of marketing content including social posts, videos, corporate templates, and other program materials. Repurpose existing content for internal and external use
Support the execution and optimization of outreach programs to engage current and prospective customers leveraging LinkedIn and other channels
Requirements
3+ years of hands-on experience in marketing campaigns plus an interest in events and community building
Experience with Marketo or other marketing automation tool
Self-directed and able to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and multiple projects under aggressive timelines and expectations
Exceptional communication, writing, and organizational skills
Well organized with very high attention to detail
Expert in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
Proficient in delivering content via social media tools, including LinkedIn
Growth minded and a team player with a positive attitude
Nice to Have
Experience developing and executing account-based marketing programs
Experience with customer retention, cross-sell, and upsell campaigns
Life sciences industry experiences a plus but not essential
Perks & Benefits
The chance to work with a genuine market leader
Huge opportunity for progression – the sky's the limit!
Incredible support from the wider team and a best-in-class tech stack to help you be successful in your role
Work anywhere policy – Yes, you can utilize our office spaces or work remotely when you need to
A wide range of perks & benefits, including a charitable giving program
Don't just take our word for it; apply here and find out more!
